description: This file defines a generic immutable Pair class used to hold two related objects, often key-value pairs, in the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: Pair
classes.description: A generic class representing an immutable pair of two elements, typically used for key-value mappings.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key element of the pair.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value element of the pair.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first element of the pair, same as getKey, for compatibility.

methods.name: getSecond
methods.description: Returns the second element of the pair, same as getValue, for compatibility.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines if this pair is equal to another object based on contained values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the pair based on its contents.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the pair in the format [key, value].

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static factory method to create a new Pair instance.
